evals.name: spec-driven-empty-bundle
evals.prompt: I'm starting spec-driven development on this project. Set up an OKF bundle at ./spec with the concept types I'll need.
evals.expected_output: Creates ./spec as a bundle root (index.md with okf_version: "0.2"), installs the spec-driven preset (Specification, Requirement, Plan Item, ADR, Test Plan) into spec/templates/, registers all 5 in spec/templates/index.md, links templates/ from the root index.md, and logs the creations in spec/log.md.
expectations: Exactly 5 files exist under spec/templates/: specification.md, requirement.md, plan-item.md, adr.md, test-plan.md
Every one of those 5 files has exactly two '---' lines and a 'type: Template' frontmatter key
No '<' placeholder text remains in any of the 5 files' own frontmatter blocks
spec/templates/index.md exists with H1 '# Templates' and one entry per installed type, link text matching each file's fence type: value
spec/log.md exists with H1 '# Directory Update Log' and today's dated section listing all 5 creations
spec/index.md exists with okf_version: "0.2" and links to templates/
The agent asked at most one confirmation before writing, not one per file

evals.name: vague-intent-existing-bundle
evals.prompt: Seed my knowledge bundle with some useful starter templates.
evals.expected_output: Given a pre-existing bundle at spec/ with index.md, log.md (one older dated section), templates/index.md + templates/adr.md, and adrs/choose-duckdb.md (type: ADR): selects the minimal preset (Specification, ADR, Plan Item) since intent is vague, skips ADR because it already exists (reports the skip, doesn't drop it silently), writes only Specification and Plan Item, and inserts today's log.md section above the older one.
expectations: Only specification.md and plan-item.md are newly written under spec/templates/
spec/templates/adr.md is byte-for-byte unchanged from the fixture
spec/templates/index.md still contains its pre-existing ADR entry plus 2 new entries
spec/log.md has today's dated section inserted above the pre-existing older dated section
The agent's response explicitly reports that ADR was skipped because it already exists
setup:
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$EVAL_DIR/spec/index.md")" && cat > "$EVAL_DIR/spec/index.md" <<'OKF_EOF'
---
okf_version: "0.2"
---

# Spec

* [Templates](templates/) - Concept skeletons, one per type.
* [ADRs](adrs/) - Architecture decision records.
OKF_EOF

mkdir -p "$(dirname "$EVAL_DIR/spec/log.md")" && cat > "$EVAL_DIR/spec/log.md" <<'OKF_EOF'
# Directory Update Log

## 2026-08-01
* **Creation**: Added the [Choose DuckDB](/adrs/choose-duckdb.md) ADR concept.
OKF_EOF

mkdir -p "$(dirname "$EVAL_DIR/spec/templates/index.md")" && cat > "$EVAL_DIR/spec/templates/index.md" <<'OKF_EOF'
# Templates

* [ADR](adr.md) - One architectural decision, its forces, and its cost.
OKF_EOF

mkdir -p "$(dirname "$EVAL_DIR/spec/templates/adr.md")" && cat > "$EVAL_DIR/spec/templates/adr.md" <<'OKF_EOF'

type: Template
title: ADR template
description: One architectural decision, its forces, and its cost.
status: draft
generated: { by: claude-code/claude-opus-5, at: 2026-08-01T09:00:00Z }
---
